name: Pixel Art Atlas — 1.4M synthetic 16×16 sprites (CC0)
summary: Hugging Face dataset of 1,409,404 AI-generated 16×16 pixel-art sprites with transparent backgrounds and English captions, covering 6,194 subjects (items, creatures, props, fantasy objects). Generated with Krea 2 Turbo + a pixel-art LoRA. Useful as a huge placeholder/icon sprite library or for training small sprite generators. Captions are approximate.

access.license: CC0-1.0 (dataset); Krea 2 Community License applies to outputs
access.notes: Angais waives its rights under CC0 but not third-party rights. Sprites are Krea 2 outputs; Krea license §2.3 limits commercial use of outputs to entities under $1M annual revenue. AI-generated; captions unreviewed.

procedure: Open the dataset page on Hugging Face (no login, not gated).
Either stream with datasets: load_dataset('Angais/pixel-art-atlas-1.4m', split='train', streaming=True), or download the Parquet shards in data/.
Or download pixel-art-16x16-1.4m.zip (~259 MB): tokens.npy (palette indices), palette.npy, captions.json, objects.json, split.npy; decode with the snippet on the card.

verdict.why: Massive, ungated, clearly licensed CC0 sprite set (108 likes, 1.7k downloads in 3 days); honest card on provenance. Docked for AI-generated content, approximate captions and Krea revenue-threshold caveat on commercial use.
